title: Trump says he’s called for a ban on diesel exports - The Washington Post
description: The Trump administration says it is examining whether to implement a diesel export ban as prices rise. Experts say such a move wouldn’t fix high prices at the pump.

title: Hayden Panettiere died from an overdose involving fentanyl. She had just gone to rehab, coroner says - AP News
description: A coroner has determined that actor Hayden Panettiere died from an accidental overdose of several drugs including fentanyl. A report later released Tuesday to The Associated Press says the 36-year-old actor had been to drug rehab in Malibu, California, a few …

title: Sen. Jon Husted: Iran war ‘needs to come to an end as quickly as possible’ - Politico
description: His comments follow Senate candidates Ashley Hinson and Mike Rogers breaking from Trump on the conflict, as GOP panic grows over high prices.

title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark - BBC
description: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

title: ICE officer who shot man in Austin was issued a body cam but wasn’t wearing it - NBC News
description: The officer was issued a body camera but officials said it was not clear why he was not wearing it. Another officer’s body cam only captured partial footage of the shooting.
